disclaimer: Region pairs for native provider-to-provider multicloud links, copied from the providers' public documentation on the date recorded on each entry. Not a live availability lookup. Providers add region pairs, change launch stages and change supported sizes without notice; re-check the source URLs before relying on an entry, and extend or replace this catalog through MulticloudEnvironmentCatalog.with(...) or MulticloudEnvironmentCatalog.load(...). The environment ids are assigned by this catalog; the providers do not publish the ids they use between themselves.

environments.sizesNote: Provisioned bandwidth options listed by Oracle: 500M, 1G, 2G, 5G, 10G, 20G, 50G, 100G.
environments.note: AWS announced general availability with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure on 2026-07-29 (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/07/aws-announces-AWS-interconnect-multicloud-OCI-GA/). Oracle states that 500M is charged at the 1G usage rate. On the OCI side the link is a FastConnect interconnect virtual circuit and the AWS activation key is entered as the service key.
